## Governance Compliance Checklist

<!-- All items must be checked before PR can be merged -->

### Core Requirements
- [ ] I have read and understood [PHANTOM_ETHOS.md](../PHANTOM_ETHOS.md)
- [ ] I have read and understood [PHANTOM_COMMANDMENTS.md](../PHANTOM_COMMANDMENTS.md)
- [ ] I have read and understood [GITPRO_ANALYSIS_MODE.md](../GITPRO_ANALYSIS_MODE.md)
- [ ] I am operating in ANALYSIS-ONLY MODE (or have explicit authorization)

### Proposal Format (if applicable)
- [ ] All code changes use `PROPOSAL ONLY` fenced code blocks
- [ ] Each proposal includes file path and location
- [ ] Each proposal includes reasoning and justification
- [ ] Each proposal includes impact assessment
- [ ] Each proposal includes alternatives considered
- [ ] Each proposal includes testing approach
- [ ] Each proposal includes rollback procedure

### Scope and Boundaries
- [ ] Changes are within defined scope
- [ ] No scope creep without authorization
- [ ] Work remains within Phantom_PTR sandbox
- [ ] No references to private Phantom repository
- [ ] No patches intended for private codebase

### Quality Standards
- [ ] Documentation is clear and well-written
- [ ] Reasoning is explicit and transparent
- [ ] No assumptions made without documentation
- [ ] All claims are supported by evidence
- [ ] Trade-offs are clearly presented

### Architectural Integrity
- [ ] Existing patterns and conventions respected
- [ ] No layer violations introduced
- [ ] Modularity preserved or improved
- [ ] No tight coupling added
- [ ] Clean separation of concerns maintained

### Security and License
- [ ] No hardcoded credentials or secrets
- [ ] No security vulnerabilities introduced
- [ ] Complies with MIT license
- [ ] No proprietary material included
- [ ] Proper attribution for third-party content

### Reversibility
- [ ] All changes are reversible
- [ ] Rollback procedures documented
- [ ] Original state preserved or documented
- [ ] No irreversible operations without explicit authorization
